recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist composition featuring a large field of muted blue-grey negative space with a small, vertically oriented rectangular portrait inset in the lower right quadrant. The typography is restricted to a single horizontal band at the very top, creating a stark, modern aesthetic typical of late 1960s soul and jazz records.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme ratio of negative space to subject imagery
Asymmetrical balance between top-aligned text and bottom-right portrait
Tonal harmony between the cool background and the warm skin tones of the portrait
Strict geometric alignment of the inset image against the organic curves of the face
coreInvariants: High-contrast lighting on the subject's face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a tight headshot contained within a vertical rectangle, positioned in the lower right quadrant, occupying approximately 20% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The inset portrait serves as the primary visual anchor, providing the only high-detail and high-contrast area.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top-left text, moves across the header, then drops down the large empty field to the portrait in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant; approximately 75% of the canvas is a flat, textured blue-grey field.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Brown and Warm Amber (Portrait shadows and highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast within the small portrait area.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Extremely tight kerning where characters almost touch

composition.position: Top edge, spanning most of the width

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for all text elements to maintain minimalist rigor.
graphicDevices: Vertical rectangular frame for the photo
Subtle paper texture across the entire surface

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bold, industrial weight and tight spacing of the era.
Provides the clean, geometric structure seen in 60s soul covers.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a flat, slightly textured slate-blue background. In the lower right quadrant, place a vertical rectangular portrait of a person with warm lighting and deep shadows, ensuring the portrait is small relative to the total canvas size.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of bold, uppercase sans-serif text along the top edge. Use a dark navy color for the text and apply very tight tracking so the letters nearly touch.

verificationChecks: Is the background a single muted color?
Is the portrait confined to a small vertical rectangle in the bottom right?
Is the text strictly at the top and set in bold uppercase?
Is there a significant amount of empty space in the center and left?

adjustableVariables: Exact size of the portrait rectangle
mustRedesign: Record label logos in the corners
Catalog numbers in the top left

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp edges on the portrait frame

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible but tight.
Confirm the portrait does not exceed 25% of the total area.
Check that the background color is consistent and desaturated.
Verify the composition feels bottom-heavy on the right side.
recipe.reuseFormula: Muted Field + Top-Aligned Bold Sans + Lower-Right Inset Portrait = 1960s Minimalist Soul Aesthetic
